reference_basis: Applied end forces and original undeformed positions, static free-body equilibrium and independently selected positive scalar spring laws; never fitted from stresses, RF/SOF/SOM, CF or observed output signs.

scalar_connector_references.definition: PortB generalized value minus PortA generalized value along the declared global axis, bound to original native RefNode/RotNode sets
scalar_connector_references.separated_reference_couple_proof: rB-rA=(10,0,0)mm is parallel to F=(12,0,0)N; its cross product is exactly zero. Finite backbone compliance changes common motion, not the statically determined spring force/relative extension or torque/relative rotation.

acceptance.nonzero_reference_metric: Euclidean norm(actual-reference)/Euclidean norm(reference), force and original-origin moment separately, each retained body and global support separately
acceptance.zero_body_channel_and_balance_metric: Euclidean norm(actual)/the frozen per-branch applied force or original-origin moment scale; global support balance uses the frozen whole-applied scales
acceptance.differential_scalar_metric: Absolute error divided by0.01mm for Ux or0.001rad for Rx; zero transverse differences use these same predeclared translational/rotational scales, not a response-fitted floor
acceptance.local_scalar_torque_check: Also compare k_rx*delta_rx with6Nmm separately; the large global spatial moments must not mask a wrong transmitted torque.
acceptance.capacity_count_and_incidence_checks: Exact equality, not a relative tolerance. A single missing, duplicate or swapped declaration/owner/endpoint is a failure even if aggregate load error is below1%.
acceptance.absolute_backbone_motion_target: None. Prove finite nonzero actual motion and free native modes without fitting an absolute displacement or sign.
